notes.title: Small Patch #5
notes.content:
A bit bigger than small! 
- You can now stun and harvest planet side life forms! The further away from Starport, the more valuable they are. Also, be careful they can hurt you. 
- Graphical enhancements including higher resolution textures, better skybox and better clouds.
- Fixed a very minor bug with the combat simulator.

notes.title: Small Patch #4
notes.content:
- Fixed keyboard locking bug.
- Androids no longer complain about training.
- Clearer indication when you've selected a landing spot that's under the ocean.
- Less wordy combat simulator text with cleaner instructions.

notes.title: Small Patch #3
notes.content:
Hi all! 

As I receive bits of feedback this solo dev will continue to make improvements. Don't mind the small downloads.

This patch:
- Simplify the welcome texts so there's less to read.
- Highlight important tutorial bits for new players.
- Make a bunch of bubble help text better.
- Increase the visibility of tutorial related text.
- Fix a small waypoint issue on the last quest.

So far, (fingers crossed) 0 major bugs. Keep em' coming, though!

notes.title: Small Patch #2
notes.content:
- Small quality of life improvements after watching others play.
- Make the small menu notification dot bigger and pink.
- Clean up some of the help text.
- Voice alert now when orbiting first recommendable planet.
- Don't pester about saving games if the player has saved their game.

notes.title: Minor update to help notes, easier initial combat scene.
notes.content:
- Small patch
- Encourage player to save their new games
- Easier initial combat scene
